experiment: C8 exploratory depth-3 recursive hierarchy and error scaling

paths.strict: pair-align at Level1, then recursive compile Level1->Level2->Level3 with no original 4-block or 8-block targets after Level1 pair compilation
paths.realign_each_level: same Level1; before each Level2 compile jointly align child Level1 units to original 4-block span, freeze, compile; before Level3 compile jointly align two Level2 units to original 8-block span, freeze, compile
paths.single_level_recursive: jointly align all 8 local candidates directly to original 8-block span, freeze, compile final from cluster outputs only
paths.direct_original_single: fit matched final directly to original 8-block span

endpoints: final NMSE vs immediate recursive teacher
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory depth-3 only; not a general scaling law or unlimited recursion claim.
